## Repairs and prospective timing definition

The transport repair makes established revocation durable in the broker: a confirmed handback or definitive denial of the pinned capability latches local denial of later calls. It never fabricates successful continuity, extends robot authority, or forgives an unexplained transport failure. New request-intent and failure records retain route, association and time.

Campaign 001 used a per-tick loop origin and a differently anchored sparse journal reconstruction. Home02 passed the former and failed the latter; home03/home05 failed both. Campaign 002 retains complete compact timing samples with one explicit measured-physics origin and samples before catch-up as well as after ticks. Apply the **unchanged** frozen TimingMonitor: maximum lag strictly below 0.1 s, one-second RTF 0.95–1.05, and strictly fewer than 1% out-of-range windows. Initialization before physics and terminal cleanup after it are explicitly outside the interval, as the original monitor specification intended. Journal reconstruction remains diagnostic. This is a prospective measurement correction, not a reinterpretation of Campaign 001.

The initial stabilization uses existing WSL service warmup before host start, Windows AboveNormal host priority and a paired 1 ms timer request, with receipts. These are prospective scheduling changes, not proven explanations of historical stalls. Per-phase measurements will identify any remaining critical-path delays. Then exercise the full isolated path with the existing interruption/fresh-invocation smoke and one development pilot per family (seeds 24101–24103, fresh identities). The smoke has its existing two-invocation lifecycle protocol; pilots retain the campaign's one-invocation protocol. Require authentic queue completion, original boundary canaries, control fencing, complete evidence/retirement/continuity, independent evaluation, and strict fresh timing for the final revision. Diagnostic retries after a repair are distinct new qualification attempts, not scored repetitions. If these gates cannot be satisfied, scoring stays closed and the concrete unresolved evidence is reported.

Seal the exact final implementation, external assessor, qualification receipts, storage policy, allocation and manifests before any scored launch, then register every scored slot. Implementation changes after a scored start terminate Campaign 002 for review.

## Outcomes, stopping and resources

Keep the 900 simulation-second / 1100 host-wall-second caps, 600-second model invocation, 150-second conventional follow-through, 20 action requests, 50 observations and 512 MiB host evidence cap. Physics advances while the agent reasons. No injected scored restart, replacement, success-seeking retry, architecture comparison, ablation, simpler agent, challenge expansion or Maps + Attention work is included.

Protected independent evaluation determines task success/failure. Validity is separate: model timeout or ineffective recovery can be a valid task failure if infrastructure and evidence remain sound. Wrong sources/model/bootstrap, isolation/evaluator breach, incomplete retirement, corrupt evidence, unresolved client/transport error or strict timing failure are infrastructure-invalid. Official queue `succeeded` with integer exit 0 is required before scientific consumption; other outputs remain diagnostic with unknown task outcome.

Stop immediately for a source/isolation/evaluator/evidence-integrity breach, unverified namespace retirement or threatened capacity. Stop admission after two consecutive ordinary infrastructure-invalid slots. Invalid starts consume their slot. Do not stop early for good or bad task performance. Record every planned, started, failed, invalid and unrun slot. Never resubmit a slot with an intent, job, workspace or evidence already present; reconcile it.

Preserve all historical evidence. Monitor native and WSL growth, shared logs and free capacity. Retain a 100 GB free reserve and 2 GB retirement headroom. Allocate about 1 GiB per scored attempt plus 5 GB for qualification and investigation, with 25% planning margin; this is an estimate, not a permission gate. Modest explainable growth continues. Unexpected growth or a practical capacity threat triggers notification and an appropriate stop or adjustment, as Randy directed. No routine storage approval is required.
